name: Jobstoday Ltd.
business_model: free job posting; pay per application, click, interview or hire; homepage also lists subscription plans
notes: Homepage lists a 'Recruiter Pro' plan at EUR 89.99 a month, while the employer page says 'No subscriptions.' Employer page names Bullhorn and SAP HCM integrations and a Harvest API, but no public API documentation was found (/en/api returned HTTP 404). Language selector links were seen (en, es, pl, de) but no verbatim quote was captured.

review.note: Pricing and XML feed or ATS integrations stated; homepage and employer page conflict on subscriptions; /en/api returned HTTP 404 and no headquarters or parent is stated.

sources.title: Homepage job posting offer
sources.quote: Unlimited job posts, with 5 ATS screened applications free on every job.

sources.title: Employer pricing
sources.quote: No subscriptions. No setup fees. Start hiring without risk.

sources.title: Employer integrations
sources.quote: Import and update your jobs instantly via XML feed, no manual effort needed.
